name: Alpine Roast Café
tagline: Award-winning specialty coffee in the heart of Ljubljana
about: Alpine Roast Café is Ljubljana's premier specialty coffee destination. We serve handcrafted espresso drinks using single-origin beans roasted locally in Slovenia. Whether you're looking for a quick morning espresso or a cozy spot to work with free wifi, our expert baristas are here to craft the perfect cup.

locationContext.accessibility: Ground floor entrance, wheelchair accessible, free wifi
locationContext.parking: Street parking available, public garage 2 blocks away

faqs.question: What makes Alpine Roast Café special?
faqs.answer: We specialize in single-origin espresso and handcrafted coffee using beans roasted locally in Slovenia. Our baristas are trained in specialty coffee preparation and latte art.

faqs.question: Where is Alpine Roast Café located in Ljubljana?
faqs.answer: We're located at Miklošičeva cesta 3 in Ljubljana, Slovenia, in the heart of the city center, just 5 minutes walk from the main train station.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday to Friday from 7:30 AM to 7:00 PM, and weekends from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you have wifi and seating for remote work?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer free high-speed wifi and comfortable seating perfect for remote work, studying, or casual meetings.

faqs.question: Do you offer vegan milk alternatives?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We offer oat milk, almond milk, and soy milk as dairy-free alternatives for all our coffee drinks.

faqs.question: What coffee brewing methods do you use?
faqs.answer: We offer espresso-based drinks (espresso, cappuccino, flat white), pour-over coffee, and cold brew. All made with single-origin beans.
